classification: 10 km limited-range terrain horizon validation; NOT a complete lunar horizon
coverage_note: A finite DEM radius is limited-range even when the requested circle is fully covered; no global completeness is inferred.
profile_union_method: Per-bin maximum union of the saved native-resolution 5 m 1 km profile and all valid native 20 m samples within the requested radius.

http_range_transfer.note: COG storage blocks may include pixels adjacent to the requested RasterIO window.
